lines.en: Miku and the others are holding practice inside of the gym today on account of the cold, which I am incredibly thankful for.
lines.zh: 因为天冷，Miku 和其他人今天在体育馆里训练，对此我感激不尽。

lines.en: I mean, I don't think soccer would really go over well in the snow anyway-
lines.zh: 我的意思是，反正我也不觉得足球在雪地里能踢得下去——

lines.en: But I'm just glad I don't have to deal with standing around freezing to death while everyone else runs in circles and keeps themselves warm.
lines.zh: 但我就是很高兴，不用站在那儿冻个半死，看着别人绕着圈子跑、把自己跑暖和。

lines.en: I've gotta admit, I admire the team's dedication.
lines.zh: 我得承认，我很佩服这支队伍的投入。

lines.en: I've been coaching them for months now (You could even say I've been coaching them since the summer) and they've yet to even play a game.
lines.zh: 我带她们好几个月了（甚至可以说，从夏天就开始带了），可她们连一场比赛都还没打过。

lines.en: And I doubt anything like that would be possible if it weren't for this girl right here.
lines.zh: 而且我怀疑，如果不是因为有眼前这个女孩，这种事根本不可能发生。

lines.en: Even though all of these outdoor-loving people are trapped inside, Miku is able to keep spirits high with her never-ending abundance of energy.
lines.zh: 尽管这些热爱户外的人都被困在了室内，Miku 还是能用她那永不枯竭的能量让大家保持高昂的情绪。

lines.en: But what I like most about her is that she's still able to find time for me in the midst of all of that.
lines.zh: 但我最喜欢她的一点是，即便在这样忙碌之中，她还是能腾出时间给我。

lines.en: And of course, as soon as I think that, she tells me she needs to go back to focusing on practice and that I should pay attention as the coach.
lines.zh: 当然，我刚这么一想，她就告诉我说她得回去专心训练了，还说作为教练我该认真看着。

lines.en: The thing is, I don't even get paid for this.
lines.zh: 问题是，我干这个根本没拿钱。

lines.en: So of course, I decide to leave before I'm roped into doing anything coach-like and simply move on with my day.
lines.zh: 所以理所当然地，我决定在被拉去做任何像教练的工作之前先溜，就这么继续过我的一天。
